complaintSection.title: New Complaint Procedure
complaintSection.banner: All staff must follow this procedure — effective immediately
steps: Listen to the customer's complaint calmly and professionally. Do not offer refunds, replacements, or opinions on fault.
Record the customer's full name, contact number, product name, quantity purchased, and nature of the complaint.
Take or request photos of the product concern if available — from the customer or if the product is in store.
Do not contact Stone & Outdoor directly on behalf of the customer. Direct the customer to the Contact Page inside the counter folder.
Log the complaint with your store manager so it can be tracked and followed up if required.
Stone & Outdoor will assess and respond to the customer directly within a reasonable timeframe.
